name: Hanketsu
source:
Hero is a prosecutor in a trial held for a consecutive rape case. To prove the case women testimonies are needed. You need to delicately take them out of their state of shock, heal their heart wounds when possible and reveal the truth, of course.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名檢察官，負責偵辦一連串強暴案件。若想證明案件事實，必須取得受害女性的證詞。玩家需要小心幫助她們走出心理創傷，儘可能治癒心靈傷口，並最終揭露真相。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
